request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Frostbell Goat".

Creative brief
Name: Frostbell Goat
Collection: Frostveil Pack. Cold-climate animals adapted to blizzards, frozen lakes, icicles, and delayed shattering projectile patterns.
Core concept: A rhythmic support creature that sends staggered waves with its frozen bell.
Body and silhouette: Sturdy mountain goat with curved horns, thick chest, and a large bell hanging beneath its neck.
Signature features: Ice-coated bell, snow beard, and chipped horn tips.
Palette and materials: Warm gray, dark brown, pale blue, and dull bronze.
Movement personality: Sure-footed, stubborn, and rhythmically calm.
Attack concept: Shakes its bell three times, sending alternating left and right semicircles of frost pellets.
Directional details: The bell hangs slightly toward the left side of the chest.
Avoid: Cute farm goat, church-themed clothing, full circular attacks without gaps.
